description:
You are a QA Lead managing the release process. A regression test suite has just completed 5 runs. Build #3 has been identified as the stable release candidate.

Your task is to:
1. Navigate to the 'regression-test-suite' job.
2. Locate Build #3.
3. Update its Display Name to: 'RC-v2.1.0'
4. Set its Description to: 'Release Candidate v2.1.0 - All regression tests passed. Approved by QA team for staging deployment.'
5. 'Pin' the build (Keep this build forever) to prevent it from being deleted by log rotation.

Do not modify any other builds.
